gaps.explanation: The one budgetary schedule (Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis, General Fund, pp11-14; it covers every governmental department) counts loan repayments as charges to appropriations: General Loan repayment 1,091 (p12), Fire 2,703, Parks and Recreation 6,202, Economic Development 10,492 (p13) = 20,488; printed TOTAL CHARGES TO APPROPRIATIONS 626,374 (p14). The governmental funds statement (pp4-5) prints those same repayments under Other financing sources (uses) as 'Loan repayments' (1,091) General, (10,492) Econ Dev, (8,905) Other Governmental = (20,488) Total, and Total expenditures 605,886 (p5). 626,374 - 20,488 = 605,886 exactly. The detail lines are as printed (indexes 26, 32, 47, 51); no fix.

Statement (pp4-5) prints transfers gross per fund column: Transfers from other funds General 7,936 + Street 57,071 + Library 22,932 + Econ Dev 6,000 + Police 94,635 + Other Governmental 28,239 = 216,813 (Total, p5); Transfers to other funds General (204,377) + Other Governmental (7,936) = (212,313). 212,313 of the inflow is transfers among governmental funds; the net 4,500 comes from the business-type funds. The budgetary schedule treats all governmental funds as one budget ('General Fund', pp11-14) and prints only the net 'Transfers from other funds' 4,500 (p12; detail index 23) and no transfers out. 216,813 - 4,500 = 212,313 = the intra-governmental transfers the schedule nets out. Adding the statement's per-column transfers would double count the schedule's 4,500 line; no fix.

Statement Total column Transfers to other funds (212,313) (p5) = General (204,377) + Other Governmental Funds (7,936) (pp4-5), all paid to other governmental funds. The single all-department budgetary schedule (pp11-14) nets these intra-governmental transfers and prints no transfers out (only net transfers in 4,500, p12). Gap 212,313 = the netted intra-governmental transfers; no fix.
